newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm olein stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm olein stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trade on Wednesday, with the possible arrival of a large quantity of imported oil dampening sentiment, traders said.

They said ready palm olein in Jakarta was trading between 1,490-1,500 rupiah/kg and at 1,475 rupiah/kg for deliveries in one or two weeks. It has been trading at 1,450-1,460 rupiah/kg in Medan since Monday.
"Players are reluctant to buy in large quantities as prices might fall after the oil arrives, probably in the middle of this month," one trader said.
